summary: First full test of the GP programme (backend pytest with 26 tests + UI flows on desktop and 390px mobile). The core flows work end to end for NEW gp_signup partners: split-screen signup with stepper, Individual/Business signup with no OTP, duplicate-mobile message, resume after reload and from /gp/signup after sign-in, profile/KYC/payout validation, on-screen signing code, wrong-code error, signing, signed PDF, admin Verify/Reject, activation, card/certificate, leads, public referral, CSV rate import with all error types and versioning, ledger with status rules, GP payouts/report/statement, rate tags and 'Your rate', template placeholder block, role guards, and the legacy Pinky login with banner. TWO CRITICAL BUGS: (1) In the UI, KYC upload and admin CSV upload always failed with 422 'Field required'. I applied a hotfix for this. (2) Legacy partners have an ID mismatch, so admin KYC review, agreement signing, new leads, payouts and own-document download are broken for 112 of the 118 existing GPs.

critical.issue: 112/118 existing GPs have users.id != str(_id). serialize_doc keeps the legacy 'id', so require_gp gives uid(u)=legacy id, but raw_user/state/issue/add_payout/upload_kyc/create_referral store str(_id). Verified with a temporary TEST legacy user (cleaned up): admin POST /api/gp/admin/partners/{user_id}/kyc/pan -> 404 'Partner not found' (also reproduced on pinkynagulapally user_id 6a96f82a...). GET own /api/gp/docs/{id} -> 403. A lead added via POST /api/gp/leads is not visible in GET /api/gp/leads (total 0). An agreement issued by admin shows in /gp/me but GET /api/gp/agreement current=None, so send-code/sign return 404 and legacy partners can never sign. An admin payout for the partner_code gives GET /api/gp/payouts rows=0.

minor.issue: An invalid ObjectId gives 500 (bson InvalidId). A missing GridFS file would also 500. It should return 400/404.
item is not validated against KYC_ITEMS. 'bogus_item' returns 200 and writes gp_kyc.bogus_item. It also allows Verified on an item that was never submitted (no doc_id).

No brute-force lockout: 6 wrong passwords and then the correct one -> 200. The mobile path calls verify_password directly. Auth is a Bearer token in localStorage with no httpOnly cookie (existing app design).
N+1 queries: each partner runs state(), which calls ensure_code (writes) and may auto-activate (writes inside a GET). It is fast now (0.2s for 117 users) but will not scale to 3000.
The duplicate check is not atomic (no unique index on phone/email), so concurrent signups can create duplicate users.

ui_bugs.component: KycRow upload (Onboarding.js) + Admin Rates CSV upload (AdminGpProgramme.js)
ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: the axios instance defaults Content-Type to application/json. axios 1.x then serializes the FormData to JSON, so the backend returns 422 'Field required' and KYC/CSV upload was impossible from the UI. Added { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' } } to both calls, the same pattern as LeadDetail.js. Re-tested and both work now.

A partner who is still Onboarding lands on the /gp dashboard after sign-in instead of resuming the signup stepper at first_incomplete. /gp/signup resumes correctly when opened directly. Consider routing to /gp/signup when status=Onboarding and first_incomplete is set.

The Playwright download was named with a blob UUID ('94224d28-....pdf') instead of Bankezee_GP_Agreement_v1_signed.pdf. The anchor is not appended to the DOM before click(). The admin template download names correctly.

The iframe with the PDF blob was blank in headless Chromium (probably a headless PDF-viewer limitation). Check it in a real browser, and on mobile Safari, which often does not render PDF iframes; a text fallback may be needed.

integration_issues.flow: Admin Partners & KYC for legacy partners
integration_issues.issue: Verify/Reject call /gp/admin/partners/{user_id} with str(_id), which kyc_decide cannot match for legacy users. See the critical backend issue.

issues: The Reject, view, Edit as new version, Issue, Issue to all, partner-codes input and ledger status select have no data-testid.
Reject and ledger On Hold/Reversed/Paid use window.prompt (three native prompts for Paid). Use a shadcn Dialog with date picker + txn ref fields.
The greeting uses the first word of name ('Hello, Nagulapally' is a surname for this user).
When an item is Action Required, both 'Upload KYC documents' and 'Correct KYC items marked Action Required' tasks show (duplicate).
The tabs row overflows and 'Share link / QR' is cut off at the right edge with no scroll affordance.

Or make every query/insert use one key, and match kyc_decide on {'$or':[{'id':pid},{'_id':ObjectId(pid)},{'partner_code':pid}]}. Re-run /app/backend/tests/iter74_legacy_id_probe.py: it should show own doc 200, admin decide 200, lead visible 1, agreement current present, payout rows 1.
Keep the multipart/form-data header fix in Onboarding.js and AdminGpProgramme.js, and check any other new FormData uploads with the shared api instance.
GET /api/gp/docs/{id}: validate ObjectId and catch NoFile -> 404.
kyc_decide: reject unknown items (404) and only allow a decision when the item has a doc_id/Pending status.
Route Onboarding partners from GpSignIn to /gp/signup (resume).
Add a login lockout/rate limit on /api/gp/login.
Add data-testids to the admin Reject/Issue/Edit buttons and replace window.prompt with dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: gp_portal.py is 970 lines; split it into gp_onboarding, gp_rates, gp_ledger, gp_agreements and gp_admin modules.
state() has write side effects (ensure_code, auto-activation) and runs inside GET list endpoints.
publish_batch fallback without transactions can double-supersede if it fails partway; acceptable on standalone Mongo but log it.
auto_issue only runs when GET /gp/agreement is called, so nothing is issued until the partner opens the agreement step (fine, but document it).

success_rate.backend: 92% (24/26 pytest; the 2 failures are minor robustness issues). The legacy-partner ID bug was found by a separate probe script and is not counted in this rate
success_rate.frontend: ~90% of requested flows pass after the multipart fix. The legacy KYC review/sign path is broken

rca of the issue: KYC upload 422: services/api.js sets headers {'Content-Type':'application/json'} on the instance. axios >=1.x transformRequest converts FormData to JSON when the content-type is JSON, so FastAPI never receives the 'file' part. Fix: pass a multipart header per request (applied), or remove the instance-level JSON default. Legacy ID mismatch: utils/helpers.serialize_doc only sets id=str(_id) when 'id' is missing, and legacy users carry a different 'id'. gp_portal.uid() returns str(_id) for raw docs but the legacy id for the serialized current_user, so records written with one key are read with the other.
